map.shard_result: Confusion around workspace vs project structure leads to stalled setup

Confirmed: Delayed or missing admin invites prevent users from progressing. Participants P03 (waited on admin invite that never arrived) and P10 (could not tell trial from paid, likely due to admin setup requirements) support this insight. This barrier directly impacts step 3 of the onboarding flow where users need admin approval to proceed.

Users struggle to transition from sample to real data, causing delays in trial progression. Participants P04 and P05 both encountered this issue, with P04 unable to switch after trying sample data and P05 hitting a row limit on day two, indicating a systemic problem with data transition workflows.
